issue_request: FHIR-6833 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core correction from the 2015 May SDC tracker asking to fix unresolved links to StructureDefinition profiles on the Operation-structuredefinition-questionnaire page. The approved resolution was "fix", and Jira comments record that the links were already fixed in previous work.
initial_application: No Jira-tagged FHIR-6833 implementation commit was found in the current git history. The Jira audit trail says the issue had already been fixed before closure, and the R5 source for OperationDefinition/StructureDefinition-questionnaire used ordinary markdown links to questionnaire.html, structuredefinition.html, and questionnaireresponse.html rather than unresolved StructureDefinition-profile placeholders.
additional_context: The current build keeps Questionnaire, OperationDefinition, and StructureDefinition active in source/fhir.ini, but source/structuredefinition/list-StructureDefinition-operations.xml now lists only OperationDefinition/StructureDefinition-snapshot. Commit 270e0ceb7b029dad4ca0fc5ccf5296ff370888cd removed the StructureDefinition $questionnaire operation definition and its example files from current R6 source. FHIR-27884 later corrected parameter types on the same operation while it still existed for R5, but it is a separate same-operation issue and does not require restoring the retired operation. Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later community decision requiring a current-source link fix for FHIR-6833.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The page identified by FHIR-6833 is no longer in the current build, and current source has no old StructureDefinition-questionnaire operation or unresolved links to correct.
